description: Care Coordinator logs an inbound patient call and routes to the covering care-team member. Classic Patient Services scenario for a med-device company (Insulet OmniPod pattern).
prompt: Architect HC Story: Care Coordinators need a better way to log and route patient calls for the OmniPod adherence program. Every inbound call should capture category (Clinical Question, Refill, Device Issue, Adherence Support, Billing), auto-route by category, screen for adverse-event/product-complaint content, and start an SLA clock.

hard_blockers: Persona is 'Care Coordinator' or 'Patient Services Representative' — NOT 'Patient', NOT 'user'
Pattern A ACs contain NO Apex class names, IP steps, SOQL, or *__c API names
One Pattern A AC per intake channel or edge case (happy path + AE fan-out + no-owner fallback)
Pattern E block covers Case + ContactEncounter (+ Task if follow-up flagged) with every field enumerated for the happy-path branch
AE fan-out has its OWN Pattern E block (different branch)
PHI audit AC present (RULE 16) — patient identifying info displayed
Field-level security / permission set spec (Pattern C) for HC_CareCoordinator, HC_NurseCaseManager, HC_PrivacyOfficer
Technical Implementation section present, cross-references AC numbers
Build-technology decision in header — Screen Flow first, NOT OmniScript by default (call this out explicitly)
Estimated Effort table with per-component sizing
quality_checks: Uses standard Case with a Patient Services record type — no custom PatientCall__c object
Uses standard ContactEncounter for the call event, not a custom object
AE fan-out creates a parallel Case (with PV record type) via Record-Triggered Flow, and locks the original Case from Care Coordinator profile
SLA start time captured as a datetime field on Case with a Path stage transition
OmniPod device-help scenario mentioned in scope but doesn't force a custom device-support object

Clarification Questions table calls out: (a) which telephony platform (Service Cloud Voice / Amazon Connect / Genesys), (b) PV escalation target (in-org Case queue vs external Argus/Vault Safety), (c) NCM roster source

red_flags_auto_fail: Persona is 'As a Patient' — this is an internal feature
OmniScript proposed without a rejected-alternative note explaining why Screen Flow won't work
